content: PostgreSQL EWMA via recursive CTE: seed = first-period value or simple average; each subsequent row = alpha * current_value + (1-alpha) * prev_ewma. Alpha ~0.3 (moderate recency weight). Alternative non-recursive: use weighted sum SUM(qty * power(alpha, row_num)) / SUM(power(alpha, row_num)) using window ROW_NUMBER() ordered by week DESC — avoids recursion. For weekly buckets: aggregate orders into (sku, week_number, total_qty) first, then apply weights. Key insight: pre-aggregate to N weekly buckets (e.g., 12 weeks = 3 months) then EWMA within CTE using LATERAL or subquery. Performance: for ~1000 SKUs × 12 weeks = 12000 rows, recursive CTE is acceptable in Supabase (not OLAP scale).
